description: Host helper scenarios replayed over one channel each: in process against the helper core and shell on simulated I/O (tests/conformance/test_host_helper.py), and over stdio against a real helper command, python -m entrypoints.host_helper or VIBESYS_HOST_HELPER_COMMAND (tests/e2e/test_host_helper.py). Every scenario assumes an empty registry and no project at the paths it names. The examples group runs in process only, against a helper with no example catalog (as from an installed distribution). The logs group runs in process only, over a log store seeded with the streams tests/conformance/test_host_helper.py writes; the real helper serves logs once the vs_logs store is wired (live-log-visibility PR 2).
